editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Admirals is a legitimate multi-regulated broker scoring 7.4/10 from NAFT in 2026. Five regulatory licences, Zero account pricing matching the cheapest ECN tier, and the unique combination of CFD trading plus real stock investing make it a differentiated offering. The MetaTrader Supreme Edition plugin is genuinely useful for MT4/MT5 power users. Limited by the absence of cTrader and TradingView.
